description: Triadex Muse emulator: a 31 bit shift register clocked into a repeating pattern, with four sliders picking the note and four picking how the pattern grows

params.text: Picks what the ones bit of the note number follows: OFF, ON, one of the counter divisions C1/2 to C8, or one of the 31 register bits B1 to B31
Picks what the twos bit of the note number follows, from the same list of forty
Picks what the fours bit of the note number follows, from the same list of forty
Picks what the eights bit of the note number follows, from the same list of forty
Picks the first of the four taps that are exclusive-ORed together to make the bit read into the register
Picks the second of the four taps that are exclusive-ORed together to make the bit read into the register
Picks the third of the four taps that are exclusive-ORed together to make the bit read into the register
Picks the fourth of the four taps that are exclusive-ORed together to make the bit read into the register
Clears the register and restarts the counters
Steps the register on by hand
Multiplies the note number, 0 to 16, before it reaches the CV output, 0 to 1

inputs.text: Each rising edge clocks the register on; with PWMClock set in the menu the falling edge is used as well
A rising edge clears the register and restarts the counters
Sets the eight note scale the Note output uses, one channel per note, 0-1V read as twelve semitones; with nothing patched it is a major scale
Selects what that slider follows, a quarter of a volt per position over the list of forty, and overrides the slider while patched; the jacks under the X and Y sliders carry each other's tooltip names

outputs.text: The note number played as a pitch, taken from the scale with the top bit adding an octave
A 1ms trigger whenever the note number changes
The note number times the level; at 10/16V per step it addresses sixteen steps over 0-10V

menu: PWMClock — takes the falling edge of the clock as the half step, so the module runs at the clock rate; turned off, only rising edges count and the clock has to run at double speed

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.1: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
